description: This file defines a utility enum 'TailscaleNetwork' with methods to identify Tailscale-specific IPv4 addresses and detect such addresses among network interfaces.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Determines if the given IPv4 address string belongs to the Tailscale tailnet by checking its octets.

methods.name: detectTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Iterates over network interface IPv4 addresses to find and return a Tailscale IPv4 address if present.
